After that, they endure another stormy night and face their most extreme challenge yet - crossing a 200ft ravine one by one on a rope. Bear also tests their ability to start a fire using only bamboo poles, knives and flints, before deciding which three he will take through to the Bear Grylls: Mission Survive final.

programme.title: Bear Grylls: Mission Survive 第1季
programme.desc: The final three contestants Kelly Holmes, Mike Tindall and Vogue Williams fight it out to be crowned Bear's Mission Survivor. The first task sees the group split for the first time, as the contenders abseil down a 300ft waterfall one by one. They then have to build a camp without their usual supplies, before tucking into the evening's dinner - rats, which must be gutted and cooked. The next morning, the team tackles a dense mangrove swamp, following the sound of a distress signal in an attempt to reach assistant Scott, and with the end in sight, Bear has one final challenge in store.

programme.title: Showdown Of The Unbeatables 第1季
programme.desc: This episode of Showdown of the Unbeatables features Brooklyn Bedding memory foam versus the Dynapac CC722 roller; a peanut detecting dog versus the Vortexx Pressure Washer; and Blendtec blenders versus the indestructible Bash sledgehammer.

programme.desc: The incredible journey and illustrious career of one of the most travelled men in history, this documentary tells the story of how Sir David Attenborough came to be the voice of modern natural history programs by bringing the natural world into our homes.

programme.title: Panda Power - Rise Of Furry Diplomats 第1季
programme.desc: In this episode, we uncover the origins of panda diplomacy, a strategy employed by China, utilising pandas as symbols of goodwill and friendship in international relations.\n \nThe episode showcases the various pivotal moments, from the early 20th century to modern times, when pandas were gifted to other countries. How did pandas play such an important role in softening diplomatic tensions and promoting cultural exchange on a global scale.

programme.title: Panda Power - Rise Of Furry Diplomats 第1季
programme.sub-title: The Race to Breed China’s Pandas
programme.desc:
They’re cute, cuddly and charming, and they’re one of China’s most effective diplomatic tools. We’re talking about pandas.
 
In the past decade, China has been sending pandas around Southeast Asia in an effort to build alliances. In return, countries are pulling out all the stops for these furry diplomats - from building palaces to spending millions on the care and breeding of the pandas.
 
What does this signal about China’s relationship with Southeast Asia.

programme.title: River Walks 第1季
programme.desc: This multi award-winning documentary follows charismatic blind adventurer Amar Latif as he explorers one of Yorkshire’s most stunning river valleys. As a blind man with a passion for outdoor adventure, Amar abseils into a hidden canyon, canoes across a huge reservoir, visits mysterious ruins, goes fishing for trout and meets the local llamas. It’s an uplifting and life-affirming watch as this unique presenter reveals how he takes constant pleasure from the smallest things in rugged landscapes as beautiful as this.

programme.title: River Walks 第1季
programme.desc: Kirsten O’Brien sets off on a spectacular walk along on of Britain’s wildest rivers. In this 15-mile hike along the River Tees near Barnard Castle, Kirsten explores the hidden history of Upper Teesdale. She meets some of extraordinary people who call its banks home and takes a daring wild swim in its white waters.

programme.title: Strangers In Danger 第1季
programme.desc: On a wild and dangerous adventure to Mexico, BMX bikers Rooftop and Catfish test how gutsy they really are. The pair go from racing bikes to racing donkeys, flame throwing and tricking in pointy shoes on the streets, to loosing their breakfast trying to eat eyeball tacos for lunch. But the duo’s bravery (or stupidity) doesn’t end there. They compete in a rodeo, milk a snake for its venom, spin upside down as Voladores in a traditional rain ceremony, and get tattoos right before diving into the city’s toxic sewage. With all of these dauntless activities the question becomes, can Rooftop and Catfish make it out of Mexico in one piece.

programme.title: Strangers In Danger 第1季
programme.desc: Rooftop and Catfish’s travels take them to Romania, where the daredevil acts continue. After a chariot race in the countryside, the BMX bikers continue their attempt to become Romanian gladiators by flying through the air, jumping through flaming walls, and even lighting themselves on fire while riding their bikes. They get up close and personal with the sheep of the country, trying the Romanian delicacy of sheep’s head, but quickly move on to just milking the animal. Finally, the trip to this Eastern European country is not complete without trying to clean up the streets from Romania’s stray dog epidemic. Are Rooftop and Catfish able to save the strays or does the duo learn that they are all bark and no bite.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -口渴的駱駝象
programme.desc: During a summer heat wave, something or someone – perhaps a cryptid Camenel – keeps draining the water from the wading pool.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -鎖住的門之謎
programme.desc: When Ms. Bell's prized apple-hologram marble – a gift from her own favourite teacher at teachers' college – goes missing, Addison is on the case to find out how it disappeared from inside the locked classroom.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -松果
programme.desc: Creativity has no limits! Watch Hepi and Briko transform these cones into something lovely.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -塑膠湯匙
programme.desc: Hepi and Briko reuse spoons to make some cute DIY's.

programme.title: 優可 -優可五百賽車
programme.desc: When a competitive race gets out of control, the kids have to choose between winning at any cost or helping their friends.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -超級新人王
programme.desc: The Triplets have an idea - they want to be superheroes and take over Sprinter's tasks. When they try to catch Cleopatra, they create a bigger problem than a solution.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -炸蛋風暴
programme.desc: One single egg has taken a completely wrong turning on its way to the fallopian tube. Sprinter and Leo discover that there is something strange with the egg but Bumble won't listen! It turns out that the egg is more of an explosive surprise from Boom.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -星雲
programme.desc: Kit and Mr. Battery visit a beautiful nebula. When passing through it, Mr. Battery gets lost and Kit looks for him everywhere. He finally finds him near a protostar that eats everything around it. Kit saves Mr. Battery and together they witness the birth of a new star.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -黑洞
programme.desc: A big star is missing. Kit and Mr. Battery investigate and question witnesses about this mysterious disappearance. They discover that the star turned into a black hole which now lures Kit closer and closer. Mr. Battery's quick response saves them from being eaten.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -建造堅固的城堡
programme.desc: In the Middle Ages, castles are built to protect their residents from danger. Lord Roach wants to have his castle fitted with every single type of defense system. Howle r- his architect, loves the idea. But there is something that may ruin the construction process.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -阿拉斯加之旅
programme.desc: Zoe and Milo are making ice cream when Alim arrives with a smoked herring, ready to add it in. The kids protest-fish in ice cream? Alim challenges them and takes them to Alaska, where Jamie shows them that traditional ice cream there is made with seal fat and fish.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -捷克共和國之旅
programme.desc: Alim is puzzled by Milo and his sister sharing the same last name and takes them to the Czech Republic. In Chrudim, they meet Vaclav and two puppets. Zoe and Milo offer to deliver the puppets to the museum but, due to a last name mix-up, end up on a wild adventure.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -阿根廷之旅
programme.desc: Milo, upset by his team's loss, decides to switch teams. Alim insists loyalty is for life and takes them to Argentina. They meet Sabrina, a San Lorenzo fan. After nearly causing a riot by using a wrong color, they learn that in Argentina, team loyalty is forever.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -烏克蘭之旅
programme.desc: Summer is over for Zoe and Milo, and they're not looking forward to going back to school. But Alim jumps in and wishes them... a happy back-to-school day! And to prove to them it really does exist and truly is a joyful day, our friends embark on a journey to Ukraine.

programme.title: 米麗的十萬個為什麼 -就定位...預備...去上學
programme.desc: Watching her sister do her homework, Lola decides that school is useless! Mily tells her going to school is a great opportunity. So little Lola declares that she can work without going to school! She will then realize that there's a time for everything.

programme.title: 米麗的十萬個為什麼 -我是大人了
programme.desc: 'An adult is someone who does what he wants to do whenever he wants to do it'. Mily is sure of it! To prove to her that it's not so simple, Papa Tim starts a fun role-playing game with her. What does being an adult really mean.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -小小轟隆
programme.desc: The smallest of the villains, Boom, has built a weather machine that can send devastating storms down over Bhilka. Sprinter and Leo enlist the help over the sweet Sky Whale to stop Boom.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -智齒
programme.desc: The villain DiktaThor learns what a wisdom tooth is and plans to collect all the wisdom teeth in Hilltown, to become the wisest and take over the city. Can Sprinter stop him.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -跟著光纖走
programme.desc: How do data and information travel from one computer to another? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of fibre optics. Have hands-on fun by creating fibre optic strands, and get to know Charles Kuen Kao, the godfather of broadband transmission.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -張力和化學動力學
programme.desc: What exactly is surface tension? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of materials science. Have hands-on fun by experimenting with liquid detergent, and get to know Yuan T. Lee, a chemist, known for his advances in kinetics of chemical reactions.

programme.title: 44隻貓第一季 -捕貓器
programme.desc: The garden of Granny Pina's hideous neighbor Winston is full of fanciful and unpredictable cat traps! As clumsy as ever, Meatball falls into the garden, and the Buffycats will face a super difficult and funny obstacle course to rescue him.

programme.title: 愛波與小流 -看守犬愛波
programme.desc: Flo guards Flo's straw hat while Ma takes her to buy a new dress. Ebb and Bird are scared. Strange noises and Flo's hat moving by itself! It's only Jasper the boatyard cat. Clever Ebb for guarding Flo's hat. Ebb thinks Flo is so pretty in her new dress.

programme.title: 留校察看大冒險 -舊道路
programme.desc: The detention team follows their clue to a haunted church that supposedly reveals your darkest fears. The team splits up to cover more ground. Scared and alone, they realise someone or something is following them.

programme.title: 皇家趣學院 -蘿絲的童話故事集
programme.desc: Rose's favorite Fairy Tale Collection is confiscated by Doctor LeFrog because she's distracted from her potions assignment. When Vicky and Shire Cat create a potion causing campus dragons to shrink and grow chaotically, our heroes need Rose's collection to save the day.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -貿易路線
programme.desc: Howler and Little Lewis take us on an excursion down the medieval trade routes. The journey is anything but a walk in the park for these two wine merchants! In the Middle Ages, being a salesman takes a lot of guts.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -比武大賽
programme.desc: In the Middle Ages, tournaments are all the rage! When Howler's behavior is interpreted of that as a crazed fan, he unwittingly finds himself in the shoes of a knight, embarking on a wild joust.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -多奇與鴨鴨
programme.desc: Doki stumbles upon a newly hatched duckling. To Doki's surprise, the duckling follows him! It seems like ‘Ducki' has mistakenly imprinted on Doki and thinks he's his mama! To set things right, half the team heads off to search lake Weewannanoh for the mother.

programme.title: 怪奇大歷史 -怪奇古代職人
programme.desc: Urinator, stercorarius or nomenclator, these strange professions tell us a lot about the organisation of society and the beliefs of the Romans. So when Howler doesn't have a penny left in his pocket, he discovers the most eccentric jobs of antiquity.

programme.title: 怪奇大歷史 -雙輪馬車競賽
programme.desc: In Ancient Rome, chariot racing was a huge success! Howler and Columba meet at the Circus Maximus to support their champion in an electric atmosphere. But be warned: with the craziest supporters, you can expect anything.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -大猩猩醫腳
programme.desc: Ubongo, the gorilla, has a massive cut on his foot. But how do you treat a 400-pound gorilla with a sore foot? And have you ever seen a sloth take a shower? Hugo, the sloth, will draw back the shower curtain and reveal all.

programme.title: 華麗的冒險 -魁北克
programme.desc: Quebec winter thrill: Dogsledding, ice sculpting, hockey lesson with local teens, and extreme sledding at Village Vacances Valcartier. A week of icy adventures with Nicole in Canada.

programme.title: 華麗的冒險 -紐奧良
programme.desc: New Orleans charm: Culinary delights at New Orleans School of Cooking, swamp tour with alligators, Habitat for Humanity in the 9th ward, and jazz appreciation at a local music club. A week of rich experiences with Nicole and local teens in the vibrant city.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -髒兮兮
programme.desc: Sir Howler is expecting a visit from the king any second! Only problem is, the town where he lives is a total garbage dump! So the Little Urchins get to work to make the place look spic and span, demonstrating the spectrum of medieval cleaning techniques.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -星雲
programme.desc: Kit and Mr. Battery visit a beautiful nebula. When passing through it, Mr. Battery gets lost and Kit looks for him everywhere. He finally finds him near a protostar that eats everything around it. Kit saves Mr. Battery and together they witness the birth of a new star.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -黑洞
programme.desc: A big star is missing. Kit and Mr. Battery investigate and question witnesses about this mysterious disappearance. They discover that the star turned into a black hole which now lures Kit closer and closer. Mr. Battery's quick response saves them from being eaten.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -建造堅固的城堡
programme.desc: In the Middle Ages, castles are built to protect their residents from danger. Lord Roach wants to have his castle fitted with every single type of defense system. Howle r- his architect, loves the idea. But there is something that may ruin the construction process.

programme.title: 深海大探險 -奇怪的遷徙
programme.desc: The Rover is swallowed by a huge shark! Will and Fontaine end up in its mouth. It's up to Kaiko and Ant to try to find a way to free them.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -秘密訊息
programme.desc: Eric learns that, with a little science, you can bring out all the colours that make up the black ink in felt tip markers. He separates the colours using chromatography. This gives him a way to write secret messages.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -隱形男孩
programme.desc: Bored, Robbie visits Motor and secretly takes his invisibility helmet. Now invisible, he pranks everyone! But soon he realizes being unseen isn't so fun after all. The helmet's locked, and he needs help-how do you take off something no one can see... or reach.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -遊戲結束
programme.desc: Flippy's having the worst day-until a short-circuit at the cafe turns his world into a video game! Now he has three lives per level and total control. It's the escape he wanted... or is it? Even in games, you have to face challenges. What happens if he runs out of lives.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -貿易路線
programme.desc: Howler and Little Lewis take us on an excursion down the medieval trade routes. The journey is anything but a walk in the park for these two wine merchants! In the Middle Ages, being a salesman takes a lot of guts.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -巖池的奧秘
programme.desc: While admiring the sea life in an ocean rock pool, Darwin & Newts discover that the water level is lowering. They try to stop the leak to save the creatures, but learn that they didn't need to worry.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -大霧中的青蛙
programme.desc: A heavy sea fog rolls in while Darwin and Burpee are on the island, so Newts and Kea need to build a lighthouse to help them navigate the waka home.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -噎住的急救步驟
programme.desc: Dr Chris and Dr Xand give First-Aid tips to help save someone from choking. The Ouch-Mobile solves more medical mysteries, and the doctors look back at the best bits of Operation Ouch.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -令人欽佩的水中上將
programme.desc: Eric learns that even if something is made from a material that is denser or heavier than water, it will float if it has the right shape. He makes a paper boat strong enough to carry toy cars without sinking.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -折射上的反射
programme.desc: Eric does a fun experiment to show how refraction plays tricks with our eyes. He learns that when we look at objects, we see the light reflected from them. Because light doesn't travel as well through water as it does through air, things in water look different to us.

programme.title: 天氣小英雄 -救援馴鹿
programme.desc: A group of reindeer on Victoria Island can't cross back to the mainland. Global warming has made the ice, on which the herd usually crosses, too thin and weak to support their weight. Thermo and Nix must find a way to get the reindeer safely home.

programme.title: 天氣小英雄 -煙霧怪獸
programme.desc: There's been an emergency in the Jiangsu province of China. Air pollution is choking entire cities, and planes can't even take off because of the smog! People can't breathe the polluted air! Only the MeteoHeroes can prevent an environmental catastrophe.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -環保科學和回收
programme.desc: What's the difference between science and green science? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of renewable energy. Have hands-on fun by making your lettuce sustainable, and get to know Ryoji Noyori, a chemist and great advocate of green chemistry.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -A4紙張
programme.desc: Blank paper? No problem, Hepi and Briko are full of ideas.

programme.title: 動物電視台 -座頭鯨
programme.desc: Mommy and Daddy Owl struggle to understand the difference between whales - the animals and Wales - the country, leading to confusion, frustration, and a classic hit or two from Tom Jones.

programme.title: 奇妙手作時間實驗室 -潛望鏡
programme.desc: Look round a corner or over a wall, with this clever device you can see like you're tall.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -菲可的城牆
programme.desc: When Fico's messiness causes friction at the clubhouse, Gabi suggests they build a wall around his space. But could a big wall really stop the fighting? To find out, Doki, Mundi, and Anabella fly to The Great Wall of China and join a restoration crew.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -多奇大量製造
programme.desc: How can we make a lot of cupcakes fast, and without getting in each other's way? To find out, Doki's team visits a toy factory in Germany where they see how an assembly line can help to make a lot of identical items in a short period.

programme.title: 神秘大探索系列: 絕讚星球 -掠食者迷思

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -神探艾伯特
programme.desc: Albert's obsessed with Sherlock Holmes and believes he shares his hero's detective skills. The others aren't so sure-except Jessi. When the class hamster vanishes from a locked cage, Albert takes the case, Jessi by his side. Robbie's the prime suspect... but is he guilty.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -童年
programme.desc: Children of noble stock receive an education in a castle environment while peasant offspring spend their youth working in the fields or at home. Daily life is busy, from a very young age. But kids never forget to have fun and goof around or playing pranks on each other.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -誰是小偷
programme.desc: When Darwin's precious Manaia goes missing, he and Newts become detectives for the day to find it.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -超級潛水艇冒險
programme.desc: Darwin and Newts turn their waka into an underwater submarine to have fun with their dolphin friend Opo.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -歌劇肌肉與草莓牛奶
programme.desc: The doctors get the help of an opera singer to reveal the hidden muscle that makes you breathe. They try a mind-bending trick and Dr. Xand uses DNA to find out who stole his milk. The Ouch Mobile is open, and at the hospital someone has stapled their own finger.

programme.title: 天氣小英雄 -魚竊盜案
programme.desc: The fish population in the Coral Triangle area is declining. The rest of the fish are showing signs of sickness for reasons as yet unknown. Pluvia and Thermo are on a mission to help however they can.

programme.title: 天氣小英雄 -奇觀之洞
programme.desc: Three children have been trapped inside a famous cave in Italy due to a landslide! Nubess and Thermo are preparing to go on their next mission. Our heroes must also be careful not to harm the cavern's marvelous rock formations.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -探索工程
programme.desc: How do simple building elements create architecture? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of construction. Have hands-on fun by building your own tower, and get to know Fazlur Rahman Khan, who came up with the ‘tube' structure in skyscraper design.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -乾燥的葉子
programme.desc: Autumn is here and it's cold, but do not worry! Hepi and Briko have just the activity for us to enjoy at home.

programme.title: 動物電視台 -野兔
programme.desc: Tiny Owl is trying to explain the differences between hares and rabbits to Mommy and Daddy. Fiona Fox is engrossed in the hares on TV, and Franky has everybody in the Fox household in hysterics laughing at his terrible hare jokes.

programme.title: 奇妙手作時間實驗室 -一座橋
programme.desc: Help Pooch get over the gap by building a nice strong bridge! We're here to support you.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -水晶洞穴
programme.desc: When Oto shares his homemade rock candy, the Team sees an odd similarity between the candy and a picture of giant crystals in Oto's rock book. It sounds crazy, but are those giant crystals candy? They set off to Chihuahua, Mexico, to find out.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -天靈靈多奇靈靈
programme.desc: When amateur magician Doki accidentally makes Gabi's worm vanish, Gabi is in a panic. How can they bring Lancelot back? To find out, Team Doki travels to a magic show in Las Vegas, Nevada to ask for help from a real magician named The Fantabulous Fenn.

programme.title: 神秘大探索系列: 絕讚星球 -南卡羅萊納州
programme.desc: This week we visit South Carolina where Philippe tags tiger sharks in Port Royal Sound, spots wild venus fly traps, and examines ecosystem indicators through three different species of crab.
programme.category: Documentary, Nature, Environment, Travel, Adventure, Animals

programme.title: 破紀錄的那件事 -林凱毅: 解謎超級巨星
programme.desc: Lim Kai Yi is a record-breaking puzzle solver and holds the GUINNESS WORLD RECORDS title for the fastest time to solve ten Fifteen puzzles. Alan Pixsley learns the tips and tricks required to become a record-breaking solver from Lim.

programme.title: 破紀錄的那件事 -陳敬賢: 疊杯之王
programme.desc: Chan Keng Ian, a GUINNESS WORLD RECORDS holder and a speed stacking sensation, shares the mental and physical techniques required to achieve the remarkable speed and precision in the popular sport of speed stacking.

programme.title: 神秘大探索系列: 外太空 -太空旅遊
programme.desc: We explore the next great travel destination: Outer Space. Emily meets companies that are planning to send tourists into space over the next few years. Plus, amazing details of a 2-week vacation to the International Space Station and a return home....orbiting the Moon.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -歌劇肌肉與草莓牛奶
programme.desc: The doctors get the help of an opera singer to reveal the hidden muscle that makes you breathe. They try a mind-bending trick and Dr. Xand uses DNA to find out who stole his milk. The Ouch Mobile is open, and at the hospital someone has stapled their own finger.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -瓶中的星星
programme.desc: Eric learns constellations are groups of stars and that they often have shapes that look like animals, objects, or even people. He makes a lantern that can project the constellation Ursa Major, also known as the Great Bear because it looks like a big bear in the sky.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -酥脆的水晶
programme.desc: Eric learns that although it can take millions of years to make one crystal, he can make some in just a week with an easy experiment. His new crystals taste good, too.

programme.title: 體操新星 -成為世界最佳
programme.desc: Tumbler Seb and his teammates are off to the World Championships in Tokyo. The pressure is on for Seb - not only is he the youngest member of the team, but he has a massive new skill to pull off. Meanwhile, back in the UK, it's judgment day for trampoline gymnast Corey.

programme.title: 貝爾吉羅斯呈現成就不凡之路 -金牌女孩與太空人
programme.desc: In this episode of Bear Grylls' Becoming Xtraordinary, Kelly Holmes reflects on how she became a double Olympic gold medallist and Tim Peake shares his journey from test pilot to the UK's first European Space Agency astronaut to stay on the International Space Station.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -順風飛行
programme.desc: Eric learns how to make the perfect paper plane using symmetry. He finds out that real planes use the same principle as paper planes – when the fins point up and air hits them at high speed, the front of the plane is pushed up and the plane rises.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -重新上路
programme.desc: The Icicles are taking a huge risk and have choreographed a very ambitious routine. Charlie and Freddie are off to a competition in Guildford via Grandma's house for a sleepover. And a talented young skater from Russia has got everyone in a spin.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -瘋狂坑洞
programme.desc: Eric learns that most asteroids burn out before they reach our planet. But sometimes, when they're super huge, they hit Earth and make really big craters. He does an experiment to show what would happen in that situation.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -獾寶寶
programme.desc: Victor, the polar bear, has a sore paw, and the Junior Vets are checking on Adel, the lion, and his injured tail. Also, we meet some baby badgers that need a check-up, and Johnny and Inel bust a crafty chocolate-stealing squirrel.

programme.title: 深海大探險 -來自星星
programme.desc: The Nektons try to stop a fallen satellite's fuel from polluting a marine sanctuary. But someone else is also interested in the satellite.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -由內往外看
programme.desc: The doctors find out why we burp, and even film a burp from the inside! They meet an ambulance driver. Dr. Xand visits the Radiology department to see the view from within the body. In the Emergency Department, someone was injured doings arts and crafts.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -數學無處不在
programme.desc: This episode explores mathematical patterns in nature, such as the tessellating hexagonal units of a honeycomb, the bilateral symmetry of a leaf, and the radial symmetry of a snowflake and spider web. Math really is everywhere.

programme.title: 體操新星 -相信自己
programme.desc: After a disappointing time at the British Championships, Ekraj and Cameron need some inspiration. They are off to the Gymnastics World Cup in Birmingham to meet some of their gymnastic heroes. In the meantime, Finn and Kirsten head to the Acrobatic World Championships.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -沒有恐懼的餘地
programme.desc: Today, Sam and Saira must face their fears as they are called to the zoo to take a blood sample from Bob and Bindi - a pair of very snappy West African dwarf crocodiles. And Tuppence, the one-eyed Jack Russell, needs high-tech radiation therapy treatment.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -雙重緊急事件
programme.desc: There's a double emergency at the Vet School. Edward, the ferret, is seriously ill, having stopped eating, and a sick cow with a mystery illness needs investigating. Can the Junior Vets cope when things go wrong.

programme.title: 神秘大探索系列: 絕讚星球 -南卡羅萊納州
programme.desc: This week we visit South Carolina where Philippe tags tiger sharks in Port Royal Sound, spots wild venus fly traps, and examines ecosystem indicators through three different species of crab.
programme.category: Documentary, Nature, Environment, Travel, Adventure, Animals

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -密碼
programme.desc: Eric learns that computer coding means writing programmes that tell robots and computers how to do certain jobs. Just as we use language to communicate with other people, there are lots of different programming or 'coding' languages to talk to computers.

programme.title: 神秘大探索系列: 絕讚星球 -昆蟲
programme.desc: In this episode we explore the wonderful world of insects. At Penn State University, Philippe has a look at the complex societies ants create, learns about the importance of pollinators, and joins a team that studies disease transmission of mosquitoes.
programme.category: Documentary, Nature, Environment, Travel, Adventure, Animals

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -色彩爆好玩
programme.desc: Eric learns that if you want to create different paint colours, all you have to do is mix your paints. As long as you have the primary colours – red, blue, and yellow – you can create lots of new shades.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -艾斯特的一天
programme.desc: As head of the aquarium, Ester sets a pace that's hard to keep up with - especially on her Segway! And when a normal day includes alligators, zebra sharks, jellyfish and shark pods, you may need a Segway to keep up with this Spanish dynamo too.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -密度強度
programme.desc: Eric uses a magic trick to show how density causes some things to float and others to sink to the bottom. He mixes different substances in an easy experiment.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -生生不息
programme.desc: Eric uses a hula hoop to explore nature and create a special research area teeming with life. Using the hoop helps him identify, count and keep track of the tiny creatures and plants he finds.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -甜蜜的16歲生日
programme.desc: The pressure is on for speed skater Izzy, who's been picked to train with the Olympic squad. How will she do when she is up against her skating idol Elise Christie? And there's a surprise in store for birthday girl Kloe.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -身體不適
programme.desc: Liam is feeling very sick. Can he hold it down long enough to impress the coach with his shooting skills? Ice dancer Ella reveals just how much skating means to her. And disaster strikes for captain Emily when she falls on an already injured shoulder.

programme.title: 大地探險隊: 一起來場野性之旅 -巨蛇尋蹤, 第2部: 過往蹤跡
programme.desc: Five young explorers continue their travels through [Ai] Ais/Richtersveld Transfrontier Park in South Africa in search of the legendary Big Snake, a spirit that can transform itself into anything. They cross from South Africa into Namibia and discover some ancient art.

programme.title: 大地探險隊: 一起來場野性之旅 -巨蛇尋蹤, 第3部: 浪跡天涯
programme.desc: Five young explorers visit the biggest canyon in Africa on their search for the legendary Big Snake in [Ai] Ais/Richtersveld Transfrontier Park. They learn about geology and how the canyon was shaped and listen to campfire stories about the Big Snake.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -佐治的一天
programme.desc: As Loro Parque's head vet, Jorge never knows from one day to the next what will come through his clinic. Javier, Loro Parque's Head of Environmental Affairs, is hitting the high seas of Tenerife with a turtle tracker in hand to help with scientific research.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -小丑魚與白虎
programme.desc: We follow the aquarium team as they initiate their very own breeding program with the hope of finding many more clownfish to come. In the meantime, Lin Mao, the white tiger, has something wrong with his hip and the vets need to make a diagnosis.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -中國之旅
programme.desc: Zoe is writing a card to a friend but is afraid of making spelling mistakes. Is there a country in this world with no spelling rules at all? To find out, our friends travel to China, where people don't use letters but ideograms.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -墨西哥之旅
programme.desc: Alim knows a few countries where it is common to have insects as part of your menu. Our heroes are a bit taken aback. They decide to go to Taxco in Mexico, where Felipe is waiting for them to hunt some bugs! Grilled, they are a local delicacy.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -塞內加爾之旅
programme.desc: Milo doesn't know what to do with his old broken skateboard. Zoe thinks it is useless, so it just needs to be thrown away, but Alim thinks otherwise. He knows that his friend Baidi can recycle anything and everything. Off they go to Senegal to meet Baidi.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -巴布亞紐幾內亞之旅
programme.desc: Milo battles with mosquitoes using an insecticide spray but realises he can't win. Our heroes decide to pay a visit to their penfriend in Papua New Guinea and learn how to co-exist alongside mosquitoes.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -殭屍化
programme.desc: Motor creates a new computer game whose addictiveness threatens the productivity of the entire world.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -艾瑞克造紙
programme.desc: Eric learns how to make a beautiful sheet of recycled paper. He finds out what people used to write on before paper was invented.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -誰是小偷
programme.desc: When Darwin's precious Manaia goes missing, he and Newts become detectives for the day to find it.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -超級潛水艇冒險
programme.desc: Darwin and Newts turn their waka into an underwater submarine to have fun with their dolphin friend Opo.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -元素週期表
programme.desc: How does the Periodic Table work? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of chemistry. Have hands-on fun by decoding a secret message on a blank piece of paper, and get to know Dmitri Mendeleev, a chemist and inventor – the father of the Periodic Table.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -微真菌學
programme.desc: How to make ice cream without a freezer? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of organic chemistry. Have hands-on fun by making your own ice cream, and get to know Gloria Lim, who studied fungi, their use to humans, and their role in decomposition.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -神祕的融化事件
programme.desc: The Junior Rangers fundraiser is in danger of being shut down.Addison meanwhile is investigating a mysterious case of Tess's melting chocolate statue of herself (causes by mirrors) and is inspired to build a solar cooker to save the day on the weenie roast.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -尋寶記
programme.desc: When a geocached item seems to have disappeared along with the soil it was buried in, Addison is intent on finding out what happened to it.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -日本巨無霸
programme.desc: Doki decides to go to the Ogasawara Islands, Japan, to make his own deep sea nature video, and get footage of the rare and elusive giant squid! How hard could it be? The team learns that you have to practice and prepare before taking on big challenges.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -會飛的魚
programme.desc: Anabella creates a giant fish sculpture. Could Anabella's kooky fish really fly? She is sure it can but flying experts Oto and Mundi have their doubts. They head to a ‘birdman' competition in California, USA to try to turn the crazy creation into a flying machine.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -T恤
programme.desc: Upcycling old t-shirts to a whole new level, let's just say we make them even more cooler.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -水桶
programme.desc: No place to sit? Do not worry, we have the most creative solution for you.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -海豚
programme.desc: Today Kristina has to perform an ultrasound on Ulysses, the dolphin's, eye. But can she train Ulysses to keep her eye open long enough to perform the vital test? Meet also Garoe, a one-year-old chimp and Dali, the emperor tamarin, who has an age-old problem.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -艾斯特的一天
programme.desc: As head of the aquarium, Ester sets a pace that's hard to keep up with - especially on her Segway! And when a normal day includes alligators, zebra sharks, jellyfish and shark pods, you may need a Segway to keep up with this Spanish dynamo too.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -煉金術
programme.desc: Welcome to the world of medieval alchemy, introduced by our mad scientist friend, Howler! He's looking for a way to transmute lead into gold: it's the only way to escape insatiable Lord Roach's fort as the greedy noble seeks to increase his fortune.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -宮廷愛情
programme.desc: Dove is going through a rocky time with her horrible husband, Lord Roach. She consequently falls for Sir Howler. Despite being humble and loyal, Howler isn't always a paragon of finesse when it comes to winning the lady's heart or dealing with the jealous spouse.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -貿易路線
programme.desc: Howler and Little Lewis take us on an excursion down the medieval trade routes. The journey is anything but a walk in the park for these two wine merchants! In the Middle Ages, being a salesman takes a lot of guts.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -團團怪獸之謎
programme.desc: When the drains at Pizzamat and Hang 20 start backing up, Alex knows exactly what's caused it – a sewer-gator or maybe a blob monster from outer space. Addison has other ideas however, and is determined to solve the mystery.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -莊嚴的毛毛之謎
programme.desc: When Addison's mom, Detective Patel, comes to the school to talk about her work as a detective, she intrigues Addison and the other kids by revealing that there's an old neighbourhood rumour that a stolen art treasure, the Magnifical Mau-Mau, is hidden in their school.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -桌布
programme.desc: Let's turn the tablecloth into something festive.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -錄音帶
programme.desc: Oo we have found some old gems, let's create something cool and funky out of them.

programme.title: 優可 -優可公園裡的牛仔
programme.desc: When a truckload of animals escapes, Yoko uses her magic to turn the situation into a full-on cowboy and cowgirl adventure.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -大家都愛里歐
programme.desc: Leo feels neglected because of the affection Sprinter is getting from the Bhilkans. Cleopatra takes advantage of the situation and tries to convince Leo that Sprinter doesn't care about her. In reality, Sprinter is planning a surprise party for his best friend.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -轟隆的大爆炸計劃
programme.desc: Hilltown is blossoming with fragrant flowers. Boom has planted all the flowers to cover up his evil plan! He has been hiding stink bombs and now wants to ignite them! Our heroes must find a way, to save the day, and make it possible to breathe peacefully again.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -風暴與海浪
programme.desc: Surfing the waves leads Kit and Mr. Battery into a dangerous storm.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -最大的動物
programme.desc: Mr. Battery collects photos of the largest animals, but he's still missing a photo of the mysterious giant squid.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -傻人節
programme.desc: In the Middle Ages, life may be tough, but having fun is also on the agenda! Folly Festival is a carnival where everyone sings and dances, but also has fun trading places. Howler becomes a princess for the day, and Little Lewis a lord.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -荷蘭之旅
programme.desc: On which day in December should people receive their presents? Zoe and Milo are sure that it should be on Christmas, but Alim explains that in some countries, this happens on December 6th. They travel to the Netherlands and learn the story of St. Nicholas.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -西藏之旅
programme.desc: Zoe has started to make a mandala and she needs Milo's beautiful colouring pencils to finish it. That is not a problem for Milo, except that his pencil box is empty! How can Zoe finish her mandala without colouring pencils? A trip to Tibet soon appears to be necessary.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -布吉納法索之旅
programme.desc: In Burkina Faso, our heroes' penfriend Jamal can't wait to introduce Zoe and Milo to his parents, and like Alim, he appears to have several mums and dads. What a mystery.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -沙烏地阿拉伯之旅
programme.desc: Our heroes travel to Saudi Arabia and meet up with Ahed. He knows different ways to move in the desert by day and night, but what he does not know is where his goats have gone. He is going to need some help from his friends.

programme.title: 米麗的十萬個為什麼 -話到嘴邊
programme.desc: Maceo has a wonderful idea for the twins' birthday. Unfortunately, he can't put it into words! As a result, everyone gets angry and nobody can make up their mind. The kids will then discover the power of words.

programme.title: 米麗的十萬個為什麼 -飛走
programme.desc: Mily and Lola would like to keep the little migratory bird they've just rescued. Their neighbor Dan tells them to let it go once it's able to fly. Mily will understand that migrating is part of nature.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -我的超級英雄生活
programme.desc: Sprinter is doubtful whether he is a good superhero. Fortunately, he has Leo and Bumble to remind him of all the good things he has done since returning to Bhilka.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -朋友卡
programme.desc: A new trend, called 'friend cards' starts on Bhilka. Friend cards have pictures of everyone in Hilltown. The more cards you have, the more friends you have. But this creates a lot of issues between actual friends. So what is the true meaning of friendship.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -電流力學
programme.desc: How do batteries work? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of electricity. Have hands-on fun by making a battery using lemons, and get to know Nikola Tesla, physicist, engineer and inventor, who conceived the modern alternating current supply system.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -環保科學和回收
programme.desc: What's the difference between science and green science? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of renewable energy. Have hands-on fun by making your lettuce sustainable, and get to know Ryoji Noyori, a chemist and great advocate of green chemistry.

programme.title: 44隻貓第一季 -幸運貓奈可
programme.desc: Neko has always been the luckiest cat in the neighborhood, but it looks like now he has lost his luck and his lucky charms: he's a real magnet for trouble! The Buffycats will do whatever they can to help him regain luck and confidence.

programme.title: 愛波與小流 -愛波的冬日大衣
programme.desc: Granny has knitted an orange and purple striped coat for Ebb. Flo takes Ebb for a beach walk in the new coat. But it's too hot. Ebb takes a dip. Ebb's coat stretches and stretches. Ebb and Bird find they have a new orange and purple winter blanket.

programme.title: 留校察看大冒險 -撞牆
programme.desc: An 'obstacle course day' in gym class forces the group to reunite and work together. Meanwhile, Kelly has been missing from school, and the gang needs to find her to continue on their mission.

programme.title: 皇家趣學院 -傳說級的鐵扇
programme.desc: Regal Academy faces Shan Academy in a track-and-field competition. Hawk, Travis, and Astoria are beaten by LingLing, Princess IronFan's granddaughter. Rose must find LingLing's weakness: a love of frilly dresses, to save the day.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -判斷時間
programme.desc: Back in the Middle Ages, methods for telling the time are a far cry from the ones we know today. Church bells and the position of the sun are pretty much all they've got. So inventors are constantly trying to come up with all kinds of new systems to measure time.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -香料熱潮
programme.desc: Spices are a hot item in the Middle Ages! Lord Roach just can't get enough of the stuff! If you can't find the spice you want at the local market stall, it's probably on the other side of the world! And so off goes Little Lewis.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -多奇探險隊的大冒險
programme.desc: While practicing some circus-style tricks, team Doki gets an idea to put on a real circus show for all their friends of the Worldwide Expedition Club. Doki wants it to be amazing, so they set off to a real circus to find out how to put on the Greatest Show on Earth.

programme.title: 怪奇大歷史 -紙莎草紙技術
programme.desc: The sumptuous library of Alexandria was built by the Ptolemies to bring together all the great works of the time. But getting hold of them was no easy matter. Fortunately, with Operation Papyrus, it was no holds barred.

programme.title: 怪奇大歷史 -埃及貓神

programme.desc: Cleopatra convinces the shy Sky Whale to envelop the city in the fog and snatch Sprinter. Unfortunately for her and fortunately for Hilltown, it takes more to fool a real superhero.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -畢爾卡銀行
programme.desc: DiktaThor uses Bhilka points to put everyone on Bhilka in deep debt so that he has power over them. The only thing he miscalculated is Sprinter's wit.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -寫程式和編碼
programme.desc: How did people compute before the invention of computers? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of computing. Have hands-on fun by making your own abacus, and get to know Ada Lovelace, the first computer programmer before the invention of computers.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -瘋狂的催化劑
programme.desc: What is a catalyst? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of chemical engineering. Have hands-on fun by producing your own cheese, and get to know Ryong Ryoo, who discovered a rock trapping water inside it can serve as catalyst in petrochemicals.

programme.title: 44隻貓第一季 -和狗交朋友
programme.desc: Terry, the neighbor's dog, is staying at Granny's house for the day. It is a nightmare come true for the Buffycats, but Terry loves cats and wants to be one of them, so they decide to teach their new friend how to purr and land on his feet.

programme.title: 愛波與小流 -愛波的骨頭
programme.desc: Ebb gets a new bone to chew while Flo and Ma go to buy spring bulbs. Ebb and Bird follow but miss them at the shop. Back home Ebb's bone is missing. Oh No! Ebb finds it ‘growing' in a plant pot. Flo had ‘planted' it (like her spring bulbs) for Ebb.

programme.title: 留校察看大冒險 -世界皆是舞台
programme.desc: The kids endure public humiliation performing the worst play of all time for their classmates and family. While in between performances, the gang gains a new perspective on history and decides to put a new spin on an old story.

programme.title: 皇家趣學院 -蘿絲與龍王
programme.desc: Rose is excited for Dragon Taming Class, where they meet Low Ong, the dragon king. However, Vicky and the evil Pied Piper turn Low Ong against the school. Rose and the others must break the spell in time to save the school.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -弄臣
programme.desc: Lord Roach is feeling really down! His wife Geraldine goes out of her way to entertain him, bringing in acrobats, musicians, etc. But it's no good. Enter Little Lewis, dressed in his court jester costume and Lord Roach is very happy.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -維京人
programme.desc: Like Raven and Little Lewis, the famous giants of the northern mists, the Vikings, are master looters and navigators. Besides being bloody warriors and shrewd negotiators, the Vikings are also great explorers, out to discover the world.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -不惡作劇的菲可
programme.desc: Fico loves practical jokes. When his friend Gotcha Garcia invites them to a tomato-throwing festival, they're skeptical. Is La Tomatina a real festival? Curious, they set off to Bunol, Spain. The festival proves to be real, but Anabella won't give the tomatoes back.

programme.title: 怪奇大歷史 -辯論大賽
programme.desc: As far back as Ancient Greece, citizens met to debate the problems of the city. But if you were going to speak on the hill of the Pnyx, you'd better have known how to speak! For Howler, who mumbles and becomes confused, it's not easy to convince the crowd..

programme.title: 怪奇大歷史 -一探諾克文化
programme.desc: Famous artists known for their terracotta statuettes, the Noks were also excellent blacksmiths and incredible potters. And thanks to Howler's love of good food, they turned out to be honey experts and designers of innovative beehives..

programme.title: 動物大使館 -海豚
programme.desc: Today Kristina has to perform an ultrasound on Ulysses, the dolphin's, eye. But can she train Ulysses to keep her eye open long enough to perform the vital test? Meet also Garoe, a one-year-old chimp and Dali, the emperor tamarin, who has an age-old problem.

programme.title: 華麗的冒險 -匹茲堡
programme.desc: Pittsburgh adventure: Battled rapids on a white water adventure, savored Primanti Brothers' iconic taste, hands-on bird experience at National Aviary, and glided across the sky with the Pittsburgh soaring club. A week of diverse thrills in Pennsylvania.

programme.title: 華麗的冒險 -坎昆
programme.desc: Cancun getaway: Parasailing with local teens, exploring Mayan ruins in Coba and village of Tres Reyes, spicy chili contest, refreshing dip in Cenotes, and mastering the art of making Guacamole. A week of sun, adventure, and Mexican delights.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -潮汐
programme.desc: Lost at sea, Kit and Mr. Battery try to get the compass from the shipwreck, guarded by two surly captains.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -潛水艇
programme.desc: Kit and Mr. Battery dive into the deep ocean to retrieve Mr. Battery's lost camera.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -中世紀的衛生習慣
programme.desc: Howler isn't exactly a paragon of cleanliness! But seeing as he's got a soft spot for Dove, he needs to step up the hygiene if he wants to win her heart! So he introduces us to various medieval hygiene techniques.

programme.title: 深海大探險 -來自星星
programme.desc: The Nektons try to stop a fallen satellite's fuel from polluting a marine sanctuary. But someone else is also interested in the satellite.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -酥脆的水晶
programme.desc: Eric learns that although it can take millions of years to make one crystal, he can make some in just a week with an easy experiment. His new crystals taste good, too.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -最受矚目小孩
programme.desc: Naomi's a contestant on Clay TV's “The It Kid,” with cameras tracking her every move. She tries to show how cool and caring she is-until Jessi's quirky charm steals the spotlight. As Jessi climbs the votes, Naomi scrambles to win back the attention she's lost.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -札爾德
programme.desc: Frank finds an old amusement park machine in the basement-Zalder, who answers any question for one silver coin. No one believes it... until he's always right! Soon, everyone's using Zalder for their own goals-until Robbie breaks it and a “new” Zalder takes over.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -司法與正義
programme.desc: In the Middle Ages, safety's a little shaky. So is justice! It's ‘Sheriff' Howler's job to hunt down outlaws and bring them before the judge. But the methods he uses are a trifle different from what we're used to today.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -歡樂下雨天
programme.desc: After a day of mud sliding, the kids have to problem solve when heavy rain endangers some of the Kiwifruit Valley creatures.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -紙飛機的難題
programme.desc: Darwin and Newts learn about the different shapes of paper planes, and then have to help Heni rescue Burpee from the top of a tree.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -洗澡時的皺皮膚
programme.desc: Dr. Chris and Dr. Xand try to find out why skin goes wrinkly in the bath. Dr. Chris meets a patient taking part in amazing heart research. The doctors do a mind-bending trick, and at the hospital, one patient has a sore head and another has dislocated her jaw.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -刺激的聲音
programme.desc: Eric learns how sound waves work in the air and in water. Then he does an experiment to make sound waves travel along a piece of string.

programme.title: 天氣小英雄 -拯救黑豹

programme.title: 科學量販店 -光譜及光線

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -石頭

programme.title: 動物電視台 -小紅蛺蝶
programme.desc: Binah has her hands full with Grandad, who's acting all grumpy and claiming that butterflies are just 'fancy moths.' Fleabag and Plop explore their artistic sides as they each attempt to paint a Painted Lady butterfly.

programme.title: 奇妙手作時間實驗室 -空氣大砲
programme.desc: Have you ever wanted to fire a vortex of air? This make is a real blast.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -龍捲風的故事
programme.desc: Could a tornado really pick up a house? To find out, the team calls up Mundi's friend Luke, who's a storm-chaser. When the call ends abruptly, Doki declares a rescue expedition! The team flies to a weather station near Oklahoma City, Oklahoma to make sure Luke is okay.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -臭鞋子
programme.desc: Why do Oto's lucky shoes smell exactly like stinky cheese? If they answer that question, maybe the team can deodorize Oto's smelly shoes and the clubhouse! They head to a stinky cheese festival in Limburger, Belgium, to learn what makes things smell.

programme.title: 神秘大探索系列: 絕讚星球 -冰河國家公園
programme.desc: This week we head to the beautiful landscape of Glacier National Park, where Philippe uncovers insect fossils dating back 45 million years, spots wild huckleberries, and joins students participating in a citizen science expedition.
programme.category: Documentary, Nature, Environment, Travel, Adventure, Animals

programme.desc: Zoe Tomas and her chicken Creole hold the GUINNESS WORLD RECORDS title for the fastest time to complete an agility course by a chicken. Zoe meets Emma Salt and teaches her the basics of training Creole, the chicken, sharing why she became a chicken trainer.

programme.desc: Emma Salt meets My Mini Bakes - a viral sensation on the social media platform TikTok and holder of the GUINNESS WORLD RECORDS title for the fastest time to assemble twenty mini hamburgers! What will be the one thing Emma learns from this encounter with My Mini Bakes.

programme.title: 神秘大探索系列: 外太空 -衛星
programme.desc: We delve into the world of satellites: from small cube-sized ones all the way up to large space crafts that orbit the Earth. Emily visits one of the largest satellite manufacturers in the world to see how satellites are made and tested for the rigors of outer space.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -密碼

programme.title: 深海大探險 -美人魚

programme.title: 魔法數學 -星星之力

programme.desc: Today, the Junior Vets have to look after squealing piglets, get uncomfortably close to a giant horse that is having an internal examination, and do health checks on tiny homeless kittens.

programme.title: 一秒廚神

時光正好
programme.sub-title: 第二十一集：于海警告婉真
programme.desc: 于海警告婉真不要忘了離婚協議的規定，不要因為自己的事業犧牲了對孩子的陪伴。如果再將孩子交給陌生人陪伴，他將和婉真法院相見。李臨想盡辦法勸說李靜盡快回老家，李靜備受傷害.

programme.title: 大自然逐樣解3
programme.desc: 《大自然逐樣解3》邀請了香港大學海洋生態系博士後研究員鍾炘熾博士，分享有關石斑魚的知識。本集以香港紅斑魚、沙巴龍躉和黃釘作例子，並首次利用XR擴增實境技術，以全面生態視野去探索石斑魚的外貌特徵、食性、生活習性.

programme.title: 灣區夢成真
programme.desc: 聚焦初中組第二及第三日的行程，學生將深入探索非遺工藝與自然生態。首先參觀竹文化博覽館，走進極具嶺南特色的竹博園，欣賞以竹字為主題創作的百竹圖。學生亦會參觀肇慶古城牆，親身感受肇慶上千年的歷史底蘊。行程中還安排了互動遊戲和實用資訊分享，讓學生在輕鬆愉快的氛圍中，全面體驗肇慶的文化魅力與自然生態之美.

programme.title: 無所畏懼 (第一季)
programme.sub-title: 第一集：羅英子遭遇婚姻背叛
programme.desc: 羅英子生活在涇北市，和丈夫劉銘過著幸福快樂的生活。28歲時，羅英子通過了司法考試並取得了律師資格證，正當她以為生活會一直這樣美滿之際，卻在她準備為老公劉銘慶祝30歲生日的當天，意外收到了劉銘和閨蜜溫莉合夥轉移所有財產並逃往國外的消息，讓她大受打擊.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 千年陝菜 (第二季)
programme.desc: 陝菜千年，不只是漂浮在歷史塵煙中周秦漢唐的餐飲典範，還有浮華背後老百姓日常生活中的柴米油鹽。就地取材，順時而為，簡單質樸，清新自然，家常菜才是陝西人生活中的一年四季.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 千年陝菜 (第二季)
programme.desc: 味道橫貫秦嶺南北，舌尖盡是周秦漢唐。飲食文化上的博大與榮耀作為一種難以割捨的歷史記憶，一直是陝菜鼎新革故的強大動力。古韻今風兩相宜，陝菜從未停止過探索的腳步.

programme.title: 海鸚特攻隊

programme.title: 海鸚特攻隊

programme.title: 冰球少年
programme.desc: 冷靖在餐廳打工賺錢一事曝光，誤會沈冰冰洩密。聯大球員加入打工行列，為球隊共同努力。沈舟舟將陳宥斌的聯繫方式給簡易，期望陳宥斌能幫到球隊。陳宥斌來到聯大，因無意間冒犯胡教練，被陳徹趕走。沈舟舟來到理工大球隊，得知下場比賽對手就是聯大球隊。兩人賽場相見.

programme.sub-title: 第七集: 問題貸款後的秘密
programme.desc: 林強收到一封來自海外帳戶的匿名郵件。通過比對內部資料，林強發現了問題貸款之下隱藏著汶琥集團騙取連環貸款的巨大秘密。鄭帥勸說林強不要貿然插手。林強心有不甘繼續暗中調查.

programme.title: 前途無量
programme.sub-title: 第八集: 林強求見副行長
programme.desc: 人力資源部總經理夏馨一針見血地指出了林強的激進，並教他化解危機的方法。林強求見副行長陳行遠，承認自己的遠洋漁業貸款計畫風控方面疏於考慮。陳行遠並沒有責備，林強順利過關。陳行遠對林強的態度令人力資源部副總經理羅莎替林強感到危機。錢才警告林強慎重入局.

programme.title: 海鸚特攻隊
programme.desc: 小特正在向其他海鸚展示魔術技巧，卻意外讓德仔在魔法箱裡消失了.

programme.title: 時光正好
programme.sub-title: 第二十二集：夢安將放六個月產假
programme.desc: 為了讓張總放心，夢安讓張總旁聽內容部的會議。張總知道她的用意，他告訴夢安自己雖然為夢安高興，但是六個月產假確實令他頭疼。夢安向張總表態自己一定盡其所能，產後也儘快回歸。雲階成績不佳，薛老師找她談話.

programme.sub-title: 為人民服務 - 廉政公署展覽廳

programme.title: 跑者愛也
programme.sub-title: 黎展峯/跑的記錄與傳承
programme.desc: 第十集黎展峯/跑的記錄與傳承. 〈跑者愛分享〉－黎展峯. 主持梁諾妍（Inez）與歌手黎展峯（Andy）穿梭於中半山寶雲道，從寶雲道花園出發，奔向姻緣石，踏出健步徑節奏。 Andy從球場的體育生轉變為十公里跑者，他笑言：「與朋友並肩衝刺，就是跑步最純粹的快樂！」在備戰首場半馬之際，Andy分享歌手與跑者之間的共通點，聲帶和雙腿都需要持續的鍛鍊。他深知，人生的賽道並非一帆風順，但只要不斷向前，終點自會相逢。無論是在音樂或跑道上，保持熱忱，才是最好的節奏！. 〈跑者愛迷思〉－如何提升跑步耐力？. 想跑得更快、更遠，突破自己的極限？原來除了跑步本身，波比跳和深蹲跳這兩個簡單又有效的練習，能顯著提升你的耐力，增強肌力與心肺功能，讓你輕鬆超越個人紀錄！. 〈鐵人跑〉. 港隊前三項鐵人代表劉峻崚（Ling Lau），退役後轉型為教練，仍然熱愛奔跑。他不僅帶領新一代三鐵學生，自己也從未忘記跑步的樂趣，繼續積極參加各類賽事。此外，他也是跑步vlogger，經常把學界比賽及與跑友一起奔跑的片段記錄並分享到網上，身體力行推動跑步文化，來一場跑步的記錄與傳承！. 《跑者愛也》 Fun Run 歡樂跑. 為進一步推廣跑步的樂趣，香港電台特別舉辦「歡樂跑」活動，邀請主持梁諾妍（Inez）、嘉賓應智越（細貓）與近一百名跑友共聚沙田運動場，一同進行3公里慢跑，並親身體驗蒙眼視障跑，感受運動與共融所發放的無限活力.

programme.title: 無所畏懼 (第一季)
programme.sub-title: 第二集：羅英子接手王大福案
programme.desc: 羅英子去了找温莉男友王良和自己的公婆，發現原來劉銘的背叛是和公婆蓄謀已久的。她只能拜託公婆家的保母蘭蘭把兩間在她名下房子的房產證找出來。同時，羅英子剛到職良誠律師事務所，積極向師父韓之通爭取嘗試獨立辦理案件，韓之通將王大福殺人案交予羅英子接手.

programme.sub-title: 為人民服務 - 廉政公署展覽廳

programme.title: 31看世界 - 超時空尋找
programme.desc: 有這樣一名戰士，在戰鬥中為了完成狙擊任務，與戰友一起趴在雪地裏三天三夜沒有動彈，當戰鬥發起時，他卻發現自己的身體早已沒有了知覺，等到他醒來後才發現，手腳已經全部截肢，這一年，他才16歲。他叫周全弟，英勇的中國人民志願軍、抗美援朝長津湖戰役中「冰雕連」的倖存者.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 超時空尋找
programme.desc: 在瀋陽抗美援朝烈士陵園英名牆上，鐫刻着197653名抗美援朝烈士名字，一批又一批遊客駐足深思、追憶歷史。許多來自全國各地的中國人民志願軍老戰士和後代來到這裏，再次唱響戰歌、緬懷戰友.

programme.title: 傷健同行好僱事
programme.desc: 工作，是靠雙手搵食，同時亦讓人靠雙手找到自己的人生方向。. 祁珈進（Enson）性格內向，不喜歡與陌生人接觸，畢業後因為實習計劃而成為了髮型屋學徒，僱主梁國華（Wilson）不但培育Enson在職場上的各種技能，更帶他參與義工工作、打邊爐甚至是溜狗，讓Enson打開了生活的世界。. 陳靜賢曾經因為障礙而迷失人生，後來在社工協助下入職花藝舍，店長Vins手把手教導靜賢買花、送花、插花，慢慢找回自信心。靜賢因為先天聽障，咬字不清，然而，店長Vins總會聽得懂靜賢的話.

programme.title: 學人沙龍
programme.desc: 我們生活在一個前所未有的「連結」世界之中，但同時，愈來愈多人卻感到孤獨。問題或許並不在於「是否有人陪伴」，而在於我們是否真正具備與自己相處的能力。孤獨，究竟是一種需要修補的缺陷，還是一種被誤解的能力？哲學家、藝術家與心理學家，對於孤獨的理解與詮釋，往往各有不同。他們或視之為人類存在的必然境況，或視之為創造力的源泉，抑或視之為心理健康的挑戰。在這樣的多重視角之下，孤獨不僅是一種情感經驗，更是一種值得深入探討的文化與思想課題。. 主持：. 米哈(作家). 李思汝(視覺藝術家). 黃麗茵(藝術家). 文潔華(人文學講座教授). #孤獨的美學#心理作用#自處能力#情感經驗#文潔華.

programme.title: 演藝盛薈．開放舞台: 孔子傳
programme.desc: 古代教育家孔子的故事家喻戶曉，他一生跌宕起伏，閱歷豐富，弟子眾多，更留下深刻的睿智。《孔子傳》突出孔子為人師表的一面，通過他對弟子的教誨，以及求教於前輩老子等片段，帶出孔子的人生哲學。. 由男中音林俊廷飾演孔子，聲樂教授阮妙芬飾演南子(衛靈公夫人)，男高音林俊傑飾演老子，男低音林國浩飾演子路。此外，符潤光帶領的香港歌劇社合唱團參與演出。. 麥家樂(作曲、指揮及歌劇導演). 旅歐逾30年的作曲家兼指揮家，曾於2000榮獲俄羅斯文化獎，2018年成為首位華人獲得世界級「奧地利音樂劇院獎」.

programme.title: 演藝盛薈．開放舞台: 孔子傳
programme.desc: 古代教育家孔子的故事家喻戶曉，他一生跌宕起伏，閱歷豐富，弟子眾多，更留下深刻的睿智。《孔子傳》突出孔子為人師表的一面，通過他對弟子的教誨，以及求教於前輩老子等片段，帶出孔子的人生哲學。. 由男中音林俊廷飾演孔子，聲樂教授阮妙芬飾演南子(衛靈公夫人)，男高音林俊傑飾演老子，男低音林國浩飾演子路。此外，符潤光帶領的香港歌劇社合唱團參與演出。. 麥家樂(作曲、指揮及歌劇導演). 旅歐逾30年的作曲家兼指揮家，曾於2000榮獲俄羅斯文化獎，2018年成為首位華人獲得世界級「奧地利音樂劇院獎」.

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: Amy Lo 盧慧敏出生於哥斯達黎加，在香港長大，是中哥混血兒，她在大學期間被發掘成為模特兒，期後開始拍攝劇集、電影，2025年正式進軍樂壇，獲得多個新人獎項。這位多棲的樂壇新鮮人帶著兩首新作《粉月》和《綠縈》登陸《港樂．講樂》，以優美歌聲向觀眾自我介紹。. 主持. 崔潔彤. 林沚羿. 歌曲：. 《粉月》. 《綠縈.

programme.title: 《遇見美麗中國第二季》
programme.desc: 「禾下乘涼夢」的理想正在喚醒沉睡的土地，讓希望在鹽鹼荒灘上綻放。在曾被視為「地球之癬」的鹽鹼荒灘上，科技讓稻穗滿滿，創新的技術亦守護「耕地中的大熊貓」。黑地煥發新生機，糧食安全的根基正隨著土地的治癒與日益豐饒而愈加牢固.

programme.title: 睇得見。聽得到
programme.sub-title: 嚟佐敦同我地踢場波:足球小誌
programme.desc: 佐敦有一隊由多元族裔青少年組成的足球隊，除了落力踢波，他們更嘗試另一個新挑戰，和街坊傾計，講他們的日常和足球故事，這些故事更製作成為小誌成為展覽，希望讓更多人認識他們。主持愛美今集會去探訪這群足球小將.

programme.title: 大自然大不同 自然力
programme.sub-title: 大自然大不同之自然力
programme.desc: 在大自然中，覓食與求生，以及求偶和繁衍，都是所有生物的重要課題。 瀕危的黑臉琵鷺在香港尋得一處覓食天堂，得以大快朵頤；反觀極為罕見、在香港只有兩次出沒紀錄的草原鵰難得過境，卻在北部的漁塘覓食和補給時，遭到本地留鳥襲擊。成千上萬的斑蝶羣聚於山谷過冬，在遇上飢餓的獵食者黃腳胡蜂時，又能否安然度過冬天？ 春夏交替之時，各個物種都忙於繁衍後代，盧氏小樹蛙在樹林中鳴叫求偶，山椒鳥夫婦合力築巢，而鳳頭鷹的雛鳥才剛剛出生。各個物種都為繁衍後代而努力，當中的故事有成功有失敗。 紀錄物種︰黑臉琵鷺、反嘴鷸、白腰杓鷸、灰斑鴴、草原鵰、度冬斑蝶、橙腹葉鵯、赤紅山椒鳥、鳳頭鷹、盧氏小樹蛙、印度側異腹胡蜂及黑翅長腳鷸.

programme.title: 灣區夢成真
programme.desc: 高中組（趙聿修紀念中學）學生設計的大灣區行程，開展Day 1與Day 2行程，探索廣州佛山文化與科技，通過遊戲與資訊展現大灣區的傳統與現代.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 感激有你
programme.sub-title: 感激有你 - Bun 跑的綠色時刻
programme.desc: 在慈善機構Green Hour的牽頭下，一群平凡的香港市民化身為「Bun 跑一族」，默默將賣剩的新鮮麵包化成溫暖餐點，送到露宿者手中。每個麵包背後，都是對社區的關懷，讓飢餓者感受到久違的人情味，也為地球減少了一份浪費。他們不只送上食物，更鼓勵社區用行動守護環境。這次，大家一同參與「淨街慢跑（plogging）」，邊跑邊執垃圾，讓城市因一雙雙溫柔的手和堅定的腳步，變得更潔淨、更有愛.

programme.title: 運動明星又過界
programme.desc: 板球的玩法顛倒想象，以為攻擊方能夠穩握勝券？但稍一不慎便可被防守方直接擊殺出局！中國香港板球代表隊在亞運中取得驕人成績，離不開日曬雨淋的日復日練習日常。. 著名足球運動員盧均宜半「踩過界」，在熟悉的草地握起板球板，與香港板球代表兼教練陳嘉瑩（Kary）來一場世紀決鬥！幾球之後，均宜竟令Kary倍添壓力，使出港隊真功夫.

programme.title: 我親愛的 Donovan
programme.desc: Pam辭職後，Donovan因自責而冷淡以對，兩人產生誤會。外公手術成功，Pam與母親關係緩和。公司危機化解後，Pam主動協助Donovan尋姐，雙方坦誠內心，感情重新升溫。然而，Jessica突然聲稱握有其姐線索，使剛修復的關係再添懸念與醋意.

programme.title: 周末大電影 : 刀馬旦

programme.title: 香港故事 - 尾巴會說話
programme.desc: 我們的城市不斷發展，綠化帶、濕地區逐漸消失，在城市生存的野生動物，卻面臨失去棲息地的威脅。野鳥撞向玻璃幕牆、誤食塑膠、以繩索築巢致窒息、誤墮老鼠膠等情況屢有發生。嘉道理農場是香港唯一的拯救野生動物中心，中心的獸醫是如何拯救這些受傷的動物？急救的過程是怎樣？他們有甚麼觀察？被救的野生動物，怎樣掙扎求存.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 但是還有書籍 (第一季)
programme.desc: 《書海編舟記》以編輯譯者的視角出發，擺渡於作者和讀者之間，「千淘萬漉雖辛苦，吹盡黃沙始到金」。不遺餘力挖掘新人且「不擇手段」推薦作品的禿頭編輯朱嶽，編完一本書換一副眼鏡。長坐冷板凳的古籍編輯俞國林，溝通等待長達十三年終於出版了既是個人史也是西南聯大史的《鄭天挺西南聯大日記》。因曾經老師一句「拉美文學大有可為」走上翻譯道路的北大教師範曄，翻譯首次授權的中譯本《百年孤獨》，現象級暢銷書帶給他的除了榮耀，也有譯文語言風格的質疑，他坦言「翻譯是一門遺憾的藝術，艱難的快樂」.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 但是還有書籍 (第一季)
programme.sub-title: 第二集：二手書的奇幻漂流
programme.desc: 《二手書的奇幻漂流》從書店老板和藏書人的視角講述舊書的故事，強調它們承載的歷史和文化價值。台灣舊香居由父女兩代人努力，從廢品收書到業界招牌，展現了舊書的生活態度。在藏書人分享會上，陳曉維因熱愛魯迅低價購入親筆題字畫冊。80後夫妻駕書車行走中國，為水果攤主女兒推薦《小王子》，並向鄉村農民提供種植手冊，讓書籍出現在不常見的地方.

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: 這是節目第一次介紹黃豆粉。黃豆粉是日本傳統食品，由大豆製成。北海道大豆產量高居日本第一。只需烘焙及研磨即可製成黃豆粉。今次亦會有專業廚師教我們烹調簡單黃豆粉菜餚.

programme.title: 紅粉緋緋與彼得叻叻豬
programme.sub-title: (A) 面部彩繪 (B) 揚帆起航
programme.desc: A)緋緋因為李太太侄女的啟發，令她嘗試畫臉部彩繪，還為一眾好朋友在臉上畫了很多不同的圖案。不過，他們在學校的拍照日前夕，才發現竟然洗不掉臉上的顏料.

programme.title: 紅粉緋緋與彼得叻叻豬
programme.sub-title: (A) 夢想髮型屋 (B) 鴨仔奇遇
programme.desc: A)緋緋在紅粉村新開的夢想髮型屋，弄了個她夢寐以求的髮型，但她卻發現這髮型在現實中並不適合她，而且麻煩多多.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 音樂旅人

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: The legend of Hong Kong aviation began in 1925 when pilot Harry Abbott established a private flying school at Kai Tak Bund in Kowloon Bay and took to the skies for the first time, writing the prologue for Hong Kong's civil aviation. In 1998, Hong Kong Airport relocated to Chek Lap Kok, and the three-runway system has since been completed. Looking ahead, the airport will develop the "Skytopia" airport city, redefining the airport as a new urban core. From humble gravel runways to an international aviation hub, Hong Kong Airport has witnessed a city's flying dream and written a century-old story of connecting the world.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 感激有你
programme.sub-title: 感激有你 - Bun 跑的綠色時刻
programme.desc: 在慈善機構Green Hour的牽頭下，一群平凡的香港市民化身為「Bun 跑一族」，默默將賣剩的新鮮麵包化成溫暖餐點，送到露宿者手中。每個麵包背後，都是對社區的關懷，讓飢餓者感受到久違的人情味，也為地球減少了一份浪費。他們不只送上食物，更鼓勵社區用行動守護環境。這次，大家一同參與「淨街慢跑（plogging）」，邊跑邊執垃圾，讓城市因一雙雙溫柔的手和堅定的腳步，變得更潔淨、更有愛.

programme.title: 香港故事：情繫香港
programme.desc: Indians emphasize family life and attach a particular importance to the education of their children. Living in Hong Kong where the language and culture are so different, what are their thoughts and ideas about education?. Manoj Dhar used to work in the banking industry. He and his wife noticed that many non-Chinese speaking students from underprivileged families in Hong Kong could only enroll in schools mainly for non-Chinese speaking students, making it hard to learn Chinese properly, which in turn limits their upward social mobility. In 2014, they opened a non-profit making education centre, hoping to reshape life with knowledge. They are opening a kindergarten to serve more students. . Herdip Kaur was born and raised in Hong Kong, and is now a teacher in an international kindergarten. Herdip attended a non-Chinese speaking school when she was small, so she can only understand and speak Cantonese, but is not able to read or write Chinese, which has affected her career development. She therefore sent her children to local mainstream schools, hoping they would truly settle in. Besides being a parent and a teacher, Herdip is the only Indian kindergarten manager in Hong Kong. What does she think about the educational philosophies of Indian Hongkongers of different generations and backgrounds.

programme.title: 縣委大院
programme.desc: 艾鮮枝支持林志為去長嶺村做駐村幹部，村裏的工作環境跟大院裏的着實不一樣，林志為觀察着書記的言行，汲取着基層工作智慧。梅曉歌傾聽群眾看病難的各種問題，決心推行醫療改革。長嶺村的幾個村民盜伐樹木，弄斷了電線，供電和灌溉又受到了影響，當中為徐軍為首.

programme.title: 縣委大院
programme.desc: 林志為勸徐軍收手，徐軍反而説他們是在欺負老實人。縣醫院醫務科科長被名目繁多的醫改文件搞得焦頭爛額，相關政策一直變動，難以有效落實。鄉派出所抓住了徐軍等人，林志為替他們解圍，徐軍因此對林志為產生信任，告訴他自家因為父親的醫保問題陷入困境.

programme.title: 演藝盛薈．開放舞台：女人皆如此
programme.desc: 《女人皆如此》透過莫扎特的音樂，深入探討人性的微妙與脆弱，展現愛情中的多疑與欺詐。主角表面上看似堅不可摧的愛情，卻在外界誘惑下逐漸顯露虛偽的一面。他們揭示忠誠的荒謬，讓觀眾反思人性。故事背景移至1920年這個短暫而璀璨的時代，恰如其分地映射出情侶間的羈絆與脆弱，讓整個劇情更加引人入勝。. 香港大歌劇院一眾歌唱家與來自意大利巴里皮特魯切利劇院（Teatro Petruzzelli）的頂尖藝術家合作，以半舞台式製作呈獻這套經典歌劇，以意大利語演出，電視節目輔以中文字幕。音樂會片段由香港大歌劇院攝製及提供。. 指揮:艾昭羅. 監製:龔冬健. 舞台導演:華卡力. 演出:. 曾麗婷. 張吟晶. 黃華裳. 陳永. 林俊廷. 梁浩軒. 香港大歌劇院合唱團. 香港大歌劇院交響樂團.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
大自然深度遊 (普通話版)
programme.sub-title: 大潭郊野公园的日与夜
programme.desc: 人生活的地方，可以和自然环境靠近。这是大潭郊野公园的其中一个特色。. 其实，大潭郊野公园位于港岛东部，面积占香港岛的五分之一。内有四个水塘，由一条大潭水务文物径连系。. 沿着文物径，当中不少的水务设施，都已经被评定为法定古迹。例如由花岗石建造的石桥和水坝，都有过百年历史.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 感激有你
programme.sub-title: 感激有你 - 雷達爸爸
programme.desc: 天氣雷達可以有效監測天氣狀況，在颱風、暴雨等惡劣天氣下尤為重要。「打風」時當其他人趕忙回家之際，天文台的雷達機械師就要走上山頭，鎮守雷達站，應付各種突發狀況。他們長年累月對雷達悉心照料，猶如父親照顧小孩，為的就是確保雷達正常運作.

programme.title: 周末大電影：藍白紅三部曲之紅
programme.desc: 紅是看不見的線，把人的命運暗自牽連。日內瓦大學生兼職當模特兒，有天開車意外撞傷牧羊犬，竟令她闖進了退休法官的生命，無意中得知他以竊聽鄰居電話度日。二人漸漸建立起忘年友情.

programme.title: 《遇見美麗中國第二季》
programme.desc: 「禾下乘涼夢」的理想正在喚醒沉睡的土地，讓希望在鹽鹼荒灘上綻放。在曾被視為「地球之癬」的鹽鹼荒灘上，科技讓稻穗滿滿，創新的技術亦守護「耕地中的大熊貓」。黑地煥發新生機，糧食安全的根基正隨著土地的治癒與日益豐饒而愈加牢固.

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: Amy Lo 盧慧敏出生於哥斯達黎加，在香港長大，是中哥混血兒，她在大學期間被發掘成為模特兒，期後開始拍攝劇集、電影，2025年正式進軍樂壇，獲得多個新人獎項。這位多棲的樂壇新鮮人帶著兩首新作《粉月》和《綠縈》登陸《港樂．講樂》，以優美歌聲向觀眾自我介紹。. 主持. 崔潔彤. 林沚羿. 歌曲：. 《粉月》. 《綠縈.

programme.title: 時光代理人

programme.title: 優遊記
programme.desc: 【盲盒旅行團】尋找信任與慢活的座標. 黎展峯Andy再次接受盲盒挑戰——憑數張即影即有相片，搜尋遍佈坪洲島上的街坊櫈及共享健身單車，並到訪一間獨立小書店，了解坪洲因獨有地理空間而形成的社區文化。Andy最後會到訪島上唯一小學聖家學校，與不同族裔的學生大玩估語言遊戲，從中感受坪洲的慢活哲學，反思工作與生活的平衡。. 【都市漫遊】廢墟中的文藝復興. 荒廢三十五年的坪洲戲院，在有心人推動下重開大門。書店店主阿傑與街坊營運坪洲戲院，策劃成充滿活力的社區市集與展覽場地，延續昔日的街坊娛樂功能，並由此探討坪洲如何成為吸引自由工作者進駐的「磁石」，在保留生活品質的同時尋找創作靈感，展現追求心靈喘息空間的生活模式。. 【地膽導賞團】第二生命的延續. 坪洲曾是工業重鎮，如今工業式微，原居民Sherry將昔日污染嚴重的廢棄牛皮廠，用回收物料改造成充滿奇思妙想的「秘密花園」，成為島上獨一無二的藝文聚腳點。. 另一邊廂，相機收藏家小林因緣際會移居坪洲，開設小小的菲林相機店。他不為牟利，只視店舖為分享故事的空間，為過千部珍藏尋找「第二生命」，展現坪洲人知足常樂的生活態度，以及在快門聲中「一秒即一世」的情懷。. 【旅遊達人同你傾】昆士蘭餵野生海豚抱樹熊林中漂流. 澳洲是生態旅遊勝地，Mike Yuen就曾參與不同的動物之旅，包括在Moreton Island的沙灘親手餵野生海豚，去大堡礁上天下海漫步海底看壯麗珊瑚，去野生動物收容中心抱抱樹熊，統統既感動，又體會澳洲對生態保育的重視。. Mike Yuen去昆士蘭深親，因此有機會探遊較少遊客的景點，例如開恩茲的樹林漂流體驗、黃金海岸的避世海灘等。. 主持：李凱翹Kay. 嘉賓主持：袁竣鋒Mike.

We begin with Camille Love the Creative Director for Art with the Mayor’s Office, she introduces us to artist FAMAOU PECOU who has created a name for his personalized expression in modernistic art, Famou introduces us to DJ/Producer Kemit, one of the godfather’s Atlanta’s house music, who takes us and creates on screen his recordings of ‘Sounds of Atlanta’, Michael Haverty of 7 Stages theater introduces us to the theater/performing arts in Atlanta, finally Mark Jacob’s of Elliot Street Pub and Ashley Zeltser introduce us to film side of Castleberry Hills neighborhood. Bilingual: Cantonese/ English (TV Version & Web Version) Time: (First run) 2025.5.13 TUE 11:00pm.

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: Amy Lo 盧慧敏出生於哥斯達黎加，在香港長大，是中哥混血兒，她在大學期間被發掘成為模特兒，期後開始拍攝劇集、電影，2025年正式進軍樂壇，獲得多個新人獎項。這位多棲的樂壇新鮮人帶著兩首新作《粉月》和《綠縈》登陸《港樂．講樂》，以優美歌聲向觀眾自我介紹。. 主持. 崔潔彤. 林沚羿. 歌曲：. 《粉月》. 《綠縈.

programme.title: 時光代理人
programme.desc: 時光照相館為喬苓好友徐姍姍解決情感問題之餘，收穫了一份「意外之喜」.

programme.title: 冰球少年
programme.desc: 沈舟舟想要說服陳宥斌去聯大擔任教練，陳宥斌拒絕。失去北方集訓機會的陳徹無奈下，來到少年宮冰場訓練，巧遇陳宥斌。陳宥斌看出他的天賦。沈舟舟與陳徹發生衝突後，狀態日益糟糕，失眠走神愈加嚴重。沈冰冰再次偶遇趙大龍，趙大龍對沈冰冰一見鍾情，開始窮追不捨.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 感激有你
programme.sub-title: 感激有你 - 雷達爸爸
programme.desc: 天氣雷達可以有效監測天氣狀況，在颱風、暴雨等惡劣天氣下尤為重要。「打風」時當其他人趕忙回家之際，天文台的雷達機械師就要走上山頭，鎮守雷達站，應付各種突發狀況。他們長年累月對雷達悉心照料，猶如父親照顧小孩，為的就是確保雷達正常運作.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
31看世界 - 超時空尋找
programme.desc: 有這樣一名戰士，在戰鬥中為了完成狙擊任務，與戰友一起趴在雪地裏三天三夜沒有動彈，當戰鬥發起時，他卻發現自己的身體早已沒有了知覺，等到他醒來後才發現，手腳已經全部截肢，這一年，他才16歲。他叫周全弟，英勇的中國人民志願軍、抗美援朝長津湖戰役中「冰雕連」的倖存者.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 超時空尋找
programme.desc: 在瀋陽抗美援朝烈士陵園英名牆上，鐫刻着197653名抗美援朝烈士名字，一批又一批遊客駐足深思、追憶歷史。許多來自全國各地的中國人民志願軍老戰士和後代來到這裏，再次唱響戰歌、緬懷戰友.

前途無量
programme.sub-title: 第九集: 聯眾銀行遭受巨額騙貸
programme.desc: 汶琥集團董事長被捕的消息被爆出，疑似遭受巨額騙貸的聯眾銀行股價大跌。在總行的會議上，林強展示了匿名郵箱發給他的資訊以及自己查證的內容，證據直指銀行人員與汶琥集團內外勾連。林強之後拜訪錢才，詢問其與汶琥集團案是否有關。錢才否認，並勸林強調查到此為止.

programme.title: 前途無量
programme.sub-title: 第十集: 幕後黑手操縱林強
programme.desc: 聽證會上，羅莎堅稱汶琥集團貸款手續齊全，案件爆雷實際為他人陷害。羅莎被相關部門帶走調查前，與陳行遠進行最後的談話。羅莎指明，正是陳行遠引導和操縱林強一步步揭發了這早已不是秘密的一切。而陳行遠曝光真相的目的，同樣是為了自己的私心.

programme.title: 紅粉緋緋與彼得叻叻豬
programme.sub-title: (A) 時裝的樂趣 (B) 歡迎紅粉熊
programme.desc: A)莉莉、麗麗及緋緋決定設計衣服然後舉辦時裝表演，但緋緋設計的裙子卻在表演中途不慎弄破了，最後她決定改裝裙子，令它更加完美漂亮.

programme.title: 時光正好
programme.desc: 夢安榮獲了春江市十大影響力女性的殊榮，頒獎禮在周末舉行。瑞秋將夢安獲獎的事在公司大肆宣傳，為夢安造勢，夢安卻覺得太過高調，瑞秋則堅定的認為，只有關注了她頭上的榮譽，才不會過度關注她的肚子.

programme.title: 睇得見。聽得到
programme.desc: Stephanie Villaeba Gurung 今年26歲，是在香港出生的尼泊爾和菲律賓混血兒。Stephanie爸爸從小安排她就讀本地學校的華語班。大學期間，她修讀英語語言文學，這段經歷加深了她對文化研究和寫作的興趣。現在她在不同學校教文化及語言課題，還和其他多元族裔朋友一齊以廣東話主持播客節目。. 今集Stephanie會和大家分享自己對身份認同和多元文化的感受。還會和主持Carmen、Vita一齊來個美食比賽.

programme.title: 無所畏懼 (第一季)
programme.sub-title: 第三集：劉銘巨額債務連累羅英子
programme.desc: 韓之通催促羅英子寫好辯護詞，然而羅英子在會見當事人後，認為王大福案有可疑，決定要用剩餘的時間調查當事人沒有殺人的證據。此時，羅英子收到丈夫劉銘巨額欠債的追討，質問公婆劉銘借私人貸的事，卻碰冷釘子。她將事情告知師姐邱華，並拜託她幫忙尋找王大福案的證據.

programme.title: 香港故事 - 尾巴會說話
programme.desc: 在光明與黑暗交疊的世界裡，導盲犬是視障人士忠心的守護者，牽引他們走過人生的荊棘滿途，編織成一個關於忠誠和希望的故事。. 拉布拉多犬Gabe從出生開始，他的生命註定不凡，經過嚴謹的篩選，他被選中成為導盲犬，開啟了他的使命之旅。本片將會由她從幼犬到受訓練開始記錄，見證Gabe如何學會陪伴視障人士，成為他們生活中的光明使者。過程中，Gabe不僅接受了服從、導航、危險識別等複雜技能的培訓，更經歷了與訓練員之間深厚感情的建立，見證人犬情誼溫暖人心。. 隨著Gabe的訓練接近尾聲，他即將步入畢業典禮，與自己的視障夥伴進行配對。從陌生到熟悉，他們的每一次接觸、每一刻相處，都在重新定義信任與依靠的意義。視障人士的故事令人心碎，他們曾因失去視力而對生活感到絕望，然而導盲犬的出現，讓他們重新擁抱人生。冷冰冰的手杖被溫暖的毛髮代替。每一次步伐的穩定，每一次停下的等待，在導盲犬的陪伴下，視障人士重新追尋失去的夢想，見證人犬情深，便能光明同行的故事.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 未來方案
programme.desc: 交通是人類生活中不可或缺的一部份，但交通運輸是最大的污染源之一，為了讓地球變得更健康，重塑未來運輸系統的競賽已經開始，從機器人的士、無人機超級公路、零碳超級燃料，到碳中和飛行以及重新思考現時的生活方式，令我們發現一個令人期待的新未來。. 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版) 播出時間： (首播) 2024年10月14日 星期一晚上10時30分.

programme.sub-title: 第十二集: 組建新的中心支行
programme.desc: 林強在夏馨的幫助下從各個支行裡挑出十幾名業務尖子，組建新的中心支行。林強有點捉摸不透陳行遠為什麼幫自己，心裡有點發毛，夏馨幫林強梳理局勢，勸他警惕，一定要小心行事，不要成為他人的棋子。郝偉叫來張家明當證人，咬死林強是陳行遠撐腰，目的就是搞亂總行.

programme.title: 紅粉緋緋與彼得叻叻豬
programme.sub-title: (A) 地精不再胡鬧 (B) 太空舞
programme.desc: A)緋緋跟彼得發現他們家的花園原來住了一位地精諾文。諾文專門守護紅粉家的花園而且非常出色，但卻不懂怎樣跟緋緋他們玩模仿遊戲，最後緋緋與彼得決定教諾文一起享受模仿的樂趣。. B)緋緋跟朋友舉辦跳舞表演，並打算跳一隻關於太空人在太空的舞蹈。但臨表演前，飾演太空人的彼得卻想放棄，緋緋會怎樣做呢？. 播放頻道： 港台電視31 播出時間： (首播) 2021年4月18日 星期日 上午9時00分 (重播) 2021年4月18日 星期日 下午6時30分 (重播) 2021年4月24日 星期六 下午6時30分 (網上重溫) 至 2022年4月17日 星期日 . programme.title: 31看世界 - 大腦解碼
programme.desc: 著名物理學家占．艾爾─卡利里(Jim Al-Khalili)帶領觀眾跨越六億年，探索人腦——這宇宙中已知最複雜的結構——是如何誕生。從最奇異的史前生物，到最早登陸的動物、靈長類，再到人類，見證大腦如何逐步演化出千億神經元及過百兆個連結，塑造了獨特的大腦形態，並賦予我們語言的天才。本系列以尖端科學與淺白解說，在人工智慧時代反思人類大腦的獨特之處，揭示人之所以為人的故事.

programme.title: 大自然大不同 自然力
programme.sub-title: 大自然大不同之自然力
programme.desc: 在大自然中，覓食與求生，以及求偶和繁衍，都是所有生物的重要課題。 瀕危的黑臉琵鷺在香港尋得一處覓食天堂，得以大快朵頤；反觀極為罕見、在香港只有兩次出沒紀錄的草原鵰難得過境，卻在北部的漁塘覓食和補給時，遭到本地留鳥襲擊。成千上萬的斑蝶羣聚於山谷過冬，在遇上飢餓的獵食者黃腳胡蜂時，又能否安然度過冬天？ 春夏交替之時，各個物種都忙於繁衍後代，盧氏小樹蛙在樹林中鳴叫求偶，山椒鳥夫婦合力築巢，而鳳頭鷹的雛鳥才剛剛出生。各個物種都為繁衍後代而努力，當中的故事有成功有失敗。 紀錄物種︰黑臉琵鷺、反嘴鷸、白腰杓鷸、灰斑鴴、草原鵰、度冬斑蝶、橙腹葉鵯、赤紅山椒鳥、鳳頭鷹、盧氏小樹蛙、印度側異腹胡蜂及黑翅長腳鷸.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 無極飛行
programme.sub-title: 無極飛行第九集：澳洲 - 灌木林機師
programme.desc: Clark Butson在澳洲的乾旱沙漠中創建了一家航空公司，希望連結位於國家西部皮爾布拉省的偏遠社群。在這裏，飛機是與外界連繫的唯一方式。C lark的任務種類繁多：拯救行動、搭載學生、補給、礦場員工換班、探訪原住民社區等等。Clark亦會協助牧民趕牛。他們要在數百平方公里的灌木叢中，將數千隻牛集合在一起，是個非常大規模的行動。 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版) 播出時間： (首播) 2023年11月20日 星期一晚上10時30分 Clark Butson founded an airline in the heart of Australia's arid desert. Its goal: to unite the isolated communities of the province of Pilbara, in the west of the country. Here, the airplane is the only link with the rest of the world. And Clark has a lot to do to on his missions. Rescues, student transportation, supplies, rotations between mines, visiting aboriginal communities. Clark also helps farmers during "mustering," a massive operation to gather their thousands of cattle scattered over hundreds of kilometers in the bush. Bilingual: Cantonese/ English (TV Version) Time: (First run) 2023.11.20 MON 10:30pm.

programme.title: 大自然深度遊 (普通話版)
programme.sub-title: 大潭郊野公园的日与夜
programme.desc: 人生活的地方，可以和自然环境靠近。这是大潭郊野公园的其中一个特色。. 其实，大潭郊野公园位于港岛东部，面积占香港岛的五分之一。内有四个水塘，由一条大潭水务文物径连系。. 沿着文物径，当中不少的水务设施，都已经被评定为法定古迹。例如由花岗石建造的石桥和水坝，都有过百年历史.

31看世界 - 無極飛行
programme.sub-title: 無極飛行第九集：澳洲 - 灌木林機師
programme.desc: Clark Butson在澳洲的乾旱沙漠中創建了一家航空公司，希望連結位於國家西部皮爾布拉省的偏遠社群。在這裏，飛機是與外界連繫的唯一方式。C lark的任務種類繁多：拯救行動、搭載學生、補給、礦場員工換班、探訪原住民社區等等。Clark亦會協助牧民趕牛。他們要在數百平方公里的灌木叢中，將數千隻牛集合在一起，是個非常大規模的行動。 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版) 播出時間： (首播) 2023年11月20日 星期一晚上10時30分 Clark Butson founded an airline in the heart of Australia's arid desert. Its goal: to unite the isolated communities of the province of Pilbara, in the west of the country. Here, the airplane is the only link with the rest of the world. And Clark has a lot to do to on his missions. Rescues, student transportation, supplies, rotations between mines, visiting aboriginal communities. Clark also helps farmers during "mustering," a massive operation to gather their thousands of cattle scattered over hundreds of kilometers in the bush. Bilingual: Cantonese/ English (TV Version) Time: (First run) 2023.11.20 MON 10:30pm.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
前途無量
programme.sub-title: 第十五集: 總行偏私郝偉負責的支行
programme.desc: 莫惜君帶著花羽銀行的外方領導與林強談判，對方再次詢問，這項合作到底有沒有得到聯眾銀行高層領導的支持。總行多次給郝偉負責的支行優惠政策，在行政上特事特辦，導致兩家支行位於同一條街，卻給客戶提供不同的收益，引起其他支行對郝偉的不滿.

programme.title: 前途無量
programme.sub-title: 第十六集: 詐騙貸款與董事長邢禮有關
programme.desc: 錢才的太太發現了錢才留下的文件，立即去找林強，林強查看了，發現汶琥集團的貸款竟然是與董事長邢禮有關!邢禮親自來到龍源給兩家支行開會，郝偉強調龍源不該存在惡性競爭，應該合並兩家支行，林強不服，認為還沒到三個月的期限，應當遵守信用。祝豐山當眾支持林強.

programme.title: 動物童萌
programme.desc: 於本集中，我們會盤點動物王國中最具魅力的野生動物家族。從人類的表親——靈長類寶寶，到最可愛迷人的貓科動物家族，再到地球上色彩繽紛的鳥類家族。跟我們一起探索這些不可思議動物的生活點滴吧.

programme.title: 海鸚特攻隊
programme.desc: 海鸚們在雪地裡發現了一輛被棄置的雪橇後，為了誰人先乘坐而爭吵起來。可是，他們並不知道還有其他「人」也想玩這個雪橇⋯⋯.

programme.title: 海鸚特攻隊
programme.desc: 在一場雪球大戰中，佩佩和德仔被奧圖的徽章催眠了。迪迪和小特能否找到方法拯救他們的朋友呢.

programme.title: 時光正好
programme.sub-title: 第二十六集：錢副總突襲婉真
programme.desc: 錢副總突襲婉真，路過的俞辰挺身而出，救下婉真。婉真深表感激。俞辰告訴婉真，為了安全，建議她在陽台上掛幾件男士衣服，婉真笑了出來。許夢安回到家，看到冰箱裏李靜大姐包的幾百個餛飩，頗感溫暖.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 大熊貓雲川和鑫寶
programme.desc: 雄性大熊貓雲川今年5歲，必殺技是「吃」，最愛躺着吃，沒有任何一根筍能逃出雲川的嘴巴。住在雲川隔壁的是4歲的雌性大熊貓鑫寶，因為需要大量啃食竹子，一個領地裏，多一張嘴都可能導致食物不夠，所以大熊貓有極強的領地意識.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 大熊貓雲川和鑫寶
programme.desc: 自1996年，大熊貓白雲入住加州聖地亞哥動物園20多年，牠以其獨特魅力迅速成為動物園罕見的鎮園之寶。無疑備受期待的雲川和鑫寶，也將成為聖地亞哥新的超級明星。為了迎接熊貓的到來，聖地亞哥動物園正在改造原有的熊貓館.

programme.title: 學人沙龍
programme.desc: 本集從定義何謂「冒險」出發，探討從離開舒適圈、計算風險到追尋自我的心理歷程。節目透過分享各人深刻的冒險故事——從荒野露營、挑戰畏高到孤身赴日發展，剖析冒險中的得失與自我發現。我們更以神奇的魔術表演為引，反思當「知曉秘密」後，人如何持續追尋生命的驚喜與真實。最終，我們將冒險的意義從宏大的生命轉折，延伸至日常中不計劃的旅行與微小突破。. 主持:. 陳葦璇(歌手). 林家濠(哲學講師). 李澄琳(澳洲註冊營養師). 馮孟成(魔術師).

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 感激有你
programme.sub-title: 感激有你 - Bun 跑的綠色時刻
programme.desc: 在慈善機構Green Hour的牽頭下，一群平凡的香港市民化身為「Bun 跑一族」，默默將賣剩的新鮮麵包化成溫暖餐點，送到露宿者手中。每個麵包背後，都是對社區的關懷，讓飢餓者感受到久違的人情味，也為地球減少了一份浪費。他們不只送上食物，更鼓勵社區用行動守護環境。這次，大家一同參與「淨街慢跑（plogging）」，邊跑邊執垃圾，讓城市因一雙雙溫柔的手和堅定的腳步，變得更潔淨、更有愛.

programme.title: 灣區夢成真
programme.desc: 高中組（趙聿修紀念中學）學生設計的大灣區行程，開展Day 1與Day 2行程，探索廣州佛山文化與科技，通過遊戲與資訊展現大灣區的傳統與現代.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: The Health Bureau recently announced a reform of public healthcare charges, restructuring the subsidy framework for public medical services. The reform aims to guide citizens in the proper use of healthcare resources, reduce waste and misuse, and comprehensively strengthen medical protection for patients who are disadvantaged, urgent, critical, or in danger. This initiative seeks to enhance the sustainability of the healthcare system and reinforce the public healthcare sector in addressing challenges such as population ageing and medical inflation. How do different sectors view this reform? And do citizens have a comprehensive and clear understanding of it.

programme.title: 走進東盟 II
programme.sub-title: Pichai Chunhavajira, Deputy Prime Minister & Finance Minister of Thailand
programme.desc: ASEAN (the Association of Southeast Asian Nations) was established in August 1967 in Bangkok, and has come to feature ten (soon to be eleven) member-states in Southeast Asia. The comprehensive rise of ASEAN is one of the most remarkable phenomena that have defined global geopolitics and economics over the past two decades. With over 660 million people and a dynamic, young, and vibrant workforce, Southeast Asia is doubtlessly a region to watch for those who are interested in the rise of Asia and the increasingly multipolar world order. As China’s most international, globally embedded, and cosmopolitan city, Hong Kong has a critical role to play in bridging Northeast and Southeast Asia. Through rigorous, robust conversations with leading thinkers, businessmen, politicians, and academics in the region, this programme seeks to platform, exhibit, and demonstrate the fascinating intricacies and pluralities that comprise ASEAN today. . In this episode, Brian Wong, HKU-100 Assistant Professor in Philosophy at Hong Kong University interview Deputy Prime Minister & Finance Minister of Thailand Pichai Chunhavajira.

programme.title: 香港故事：邊境人家
programme.sub-title: Nam Chung: LOHAS around the border
programme.desc: Straight roads, rolling hills, and tranquil fishponds define Nam Chung, a 300-year-old Hakka village south of Sha Tau Kok. Home to five clans, it is led by young village head Chan Sai-leong, who carries his father’s legacy by overseeing an eight-year restoration of the Nam Chung Hip Tin Temple. This sacred space now serves as a hub for worship, arbitration, and community bonding. Former university professor Chan Shun-hing, a decade-long advocate for Nam Chung’s ecological revival, relocated to live sustainably with the Reed Blossom Eco-Education Fund. Through seven years of oral history, she weaves herself into the community. In this verdant haven, each resident builds their own paradise.

programme.title: 家國萬里
programme.desc: This episode examines how the unifying force of Chinese civilization has preserved diverse cultures and traditions across vast distances and centuries.

programme.title: 31看世界 -惜食料理大師班
programme.desc: Studies have shown that carbohydrates like rice, bread and noodles are the most widely discarded food group in Singapore. Whether we eat at home or dine out, carbs have long been taken for granted as ‘cheap fillers’. Our two zero waste newbies, Melissa and Benji, also have this careless attitude, so host Isaac decides to get them toiling at a mini rice field – right here in Singapore!. With a newfound respect for the resources and effort it takes to grow a single grain of rice, Melissa and Benji head to the kitchen to learn ways to transform leftover carbs. They cap off their learning journey with a unique cook-off – utilising as many types of stale carbohydrates as they can! What kind of new life can they breathe into these previously unloved staples.

programme.title: 31看世界 -惜食料理大師班
programme.desc: From use-by to best before, 80% of Singaporeans are confused by the terms printed on their food labels. What do these labels mean? And what happens if the product is past its expiry date? A typical household in Singapore throws away an average of 19.6kg of expired food every year. But does all of it have to be thrown away? . Join our two kitchen amateurs, Kelvin and Ridhwan, as they go on a zero-waste journey to uncover when expired foods should actually be discarded. With the guidance of Chef Isaac Henry, our boys will learn essential pantry management, how to decode printed labels, and even hacks on how to use expired foods in everyday cooking! . With hardly any cooking experience, how will Kelvin and Ridhwan fare in a zero waste cook-off against each other, using only expired goods.
